read.thesis: Account growth and ARPA carry service revenue up 9%, but postpaid net adds fell 13% to 277k and capex is guided flat at about $10.0B, so supply discipline is steady rather than a new signal.

capex.quote: Cash purchases of property and equipment, including capitalized interest, are expected to be approximately $10.0 billion.

triggers.label: Cash flow guide raised by $200M
triggers.quote: Adjusted Free Cash Flow, including net payments for UScellular merger-related costs, is now expected to be between $18.4 billion and $18.8 billion

triggers.label: Postpaid net adds down 13% YoY
triggers.quote: Postpaid net account additions of 277 thousand decreased 41 thousand, or 13%, year-over-year.

guidance.quote: Postpaid net account additions are expected to be between 950 thousand and 1.05 million.
Core Adjusted EBITDA, which is Adjusted EBITDA less lease revenues, is expected to be between $37.1 billion and $37.5 billion.
is now expected to be between $28.4 billion and $28.8 billion, an increase from prior guidance of $28.1 billion to $28.7 billion.
Cash purchases of property and equipment, including capitalized interest, are expected to be approximately $10.0 billion.
Adjusted Free Cash Flow, including net payments for UScellular merger-related costs, is now expected to be between $18.4 billion and $18.8 billion

red_flags.label: Postpaid net adds down 13% YoY
red_flags.quote: Postpaid net account additions of 277 thousand decreased 41 thousand, or 13%, year-over-year.

red_flags.label: Net income flat on merger costs
red_flags.quote: included the impact of UScellular merger-related costs, including accelerated depreciation, net of tax, of $146 million
